sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_stages AS (
    SELECT symbol, stage, snapshot_date
    FROM scores.stage_snapshots
    WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
),
latest_insider_alerts AS (
    SELECT symbol, alert_date, insider_score
    FROM signals.insider_alerts
),
latest_bulk_deals AS (
    SELECT symbol, deal_date, price, qty
    FROM signals.bulk_block_deals
)
SELECT 
    latest_stages.symbol,
    latest_stages.stage,
    MAX(latest_insider_alerts.insider_score) AS max_insider_score,
    SUM(latest_bulk_deals.qty) AS total_qty
FROM latest_stages
JOIN latest_insider_alerts ON latest_stages.symbol = latest_insider_alerts.symbol
JOIN latest_bulk_deals ON latest_stages.symbol = latest_bulk_deals.symbol
GROUP BY latest_stages.symbol, latest_stages.stage
ORDER BY max_insider_score DESC
LIMIT 10;

synthesis_guidance: Focus on symbols with positive insider scores and bulk deals that align with a Stage 2 technical setup. Highlight any discrepancies in accumulation patterns.
